author: reek
body: The masked frame is asserted in both directions against the same published bytes. Encoding is required to produce them and decoding is required to recover the payload from them, so neither direction is being checked against the other -- a codec that agreed only with itself would satisfy a round trip and fail both of these.

author: reek
body: The unmasked encode line is the control. It passed before any of this chapter was corrected and it must keep passing, which is what distinguishes a real repair from a probe that never worked.
